checks.note: The short_clips fact reports all seven segments present in all three narrated languages, with the longest narration 33.92 s (zh-Hans segment 6) against the 35 s ceiling; English tops out at 25.68 s, Spanish at 31.36 s. Running times with title card and pauses are 36.32 s at most, which the check allows. The chapter rails in guide-en-desktop.png (0:12 to 0:28), guide-es-desktop.png (0:16 to 0:34) and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png (0:15 to 0:36) show the same seven short chapters a patient can take one at a time.

The no_owl fact searched 18 files and found no matches. Nothing in any screenshot shows an owl or a mascot: the four panels in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png are the mastoid dressing on the head, the dressing being lifted off with an arrow, the incision behind the ear, and a magnified view of the incision with the tape strips under a "Check for tape" label. The same panels appear at phone width in guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png.

The narrator fact lists one voice per narrated language (en, es, zh-Hans) and no second speaker. The transcripts in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png are written straight to the patient ("Two days after surgery, remove the mastoid dressing"), with no character speaking and no character on screen.

The subtitles fact reports captions for all seven segments in en, es and zh-Hans. At desktop width the caption bar under the picture is legible in each language and the spoken word is highlighted ("after" in guide-en-desktop.png, "despues" in guide-es-desktop.png, the full sentence with the spoken phrase highlighted in guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png), with the Captions / Subtitulos / zimu checkbox on and the full sentence also in the transcript pane. At phone width guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png show the transcript under the player carrying the caption with the same highlight, which is the layout chosen on purpose. No cut-off or overlapping caption text in any of the six screenshots.

The toc fact lists 7 chapters, every one visible at 1280x800 in all three languages, and each jump lands exactly on its expected start (0, 12.4, 37.44, 61.92, 77.68, 101.28, 129.36 s) with the matching chapter becoming active. guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png show all seven numbered chapters with titles and times in the left rail; at phone width guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png show a "Chapter 1 of 7" picker with a dropdown and back/next arrows, so a patient can reach the part they are worried about.

The languages fact confirms the Spanish and Mandarin pages carry the expected title, first sentence and an audio file in that language, with no error status. The screenshots show the whole page switching, not only the text: guide-es-desktop.png is Spanish throughout (Idioma, Imprimir la tarjeta, Reproducir, Velocidad, Subtitulos, Linea de enfermeria) and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png is Chinese throughout, with chapter titles, transcript and caption all in that language. The phone screenshots match. No English left behind in either translated page.

The provider_file fact records two steps, paste the block and copy the link, 34 ms from paste to link, zero account or login fields, and no network requests after load. provider-filled.png shows the pasted block read into the table with the four columns Antibiotic (No), Pain medication (Yes), Follow-up (10/01/2026) and Language (Espanol), each with the Yes/No or date control the provider can override and "your block" in the From column, plus plain English under each row saying what the guide will do. provider-draft.png shows the unfilled dot phrase with its *** placeholders: the page says in words which lines it cannot read and asks the provider to choose, rather than guessing, and the note under the box says a line you leave out uses its preset. guide-from-link.png opens from that link in Spanish with the follow-up date in the transcript ("Su revision de la herida y examen del oido: 1 de octubre de 2026").

The review_line fact shows the review as a single line in the block ("Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***"), no clinician badge, and no review date in the link; the provider_file link fragment is #a=0&p=1&f=2026-10-01&l=es, carrying antibiotic, pain, follow-up and language only. provider-draft.png and provider-filled.png both tell the provider the truth in the Reviewed by row: "Stays in your note. The patient's guide shows no reviewer line" and "Not shown to the patient, and not carried in the link." guide-from-link-badges.png, the guide opened from that link with the transcript scrolled to the end of chapter 7, shows no reviewer line and no review date.

The card_summary fact reports the card on the first screen at both desktop and phone widths and the card itself returning 200. "Print the card" sits in the header at desktop width in guide-en-desktop.png, as "Imprimir la tarjeta" in guide-es-desktop.png and "dayin kapian" in guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png; at phone width the same link is on the first screen just under the player in guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png. One tap either way.
